diagnosis: EnterpriseAsset is a PolymorphicModel whose subclasses include StandardHardwareAsset and ClassifiedSoftwareAsset. The view only checks whether asset.organization matches request.user.organization. When downcast to ClassifiedSoftwareAsset, license keys, cryptographic secrets, and proprietary source hashes are returned without verifying that the authenticated employee possesses the required security clearance (e.g. user.has_clearance).
